activation_note: Staged only. This file is NOT a registration. Activation is a separate Gate-D action: Mike types APPROVE <run_id> for a gate-d run whose action names this job, after a real baseline week exists (~/.rig/proof/gate-d-<run_id>.json with status APPROVED). Until then the Hermes fleet stays frozen and neither ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json nor ~/.hermes/scripts/rig-weekly-evolution.sh is modified by this branch. A recurring job that scores zero weeks is a diary with a timer; it is armed only once BASELINE_ONLY has been replaced by a sealed prior week.
cadence_note: Sunday 17:00 local, after the week's last realign input lands; ISO week key is computed by realign.week_id(), never by the cron string.
escalations: LOOP_REBUILD_REQUIRED after three consecutive FAIL weeks
WEIGHTS_INVALID after three weeks of rising C_t with zero bookings

honest_state.bookings: ZERO by evidence — a record counts only when its qualification_evidence_path resolves to a file on disk; a zero-booking week is FAIL with its cause named, complete, never retried
honest_state.corpus: unreported unclassified_rate is not zero: the week FAILs rather than inheriting last week's number; rate > 0.10 is CORPUS_REFUSAL with nothing written
honest_state.first_week: BASELINE_ONLY when no prior sealed week exists — never reported as an improvement, no delta C_t may be claimed
honest_state.fleet_status: BLOCKED_PENDING_SENTINEL while Sentinel Prime is specification-only, even when a task-level verdict is PASS

loop_spec_state.note: The committed loop/command specs are the contract; this file is a local staging pointer and is gitignored by design.

name: RIG Realign Loop v1 — weekly convergence scoring
staging_pointer: .context/realign/cron-job.json (gitignored; a local pointer, not the contract)
why_tracked: A dormant job that exists only in a gitignored directory ships nothing: a fresh clone cannot see the cadence, the gate, or the honest state. The tracked copy is the contract; enabled:false and gate_d_required:true make dormancy explicit in the artifact itself.
writes: .context/realign/<YYYY-Www>/ — five artifacts (register-diff.json, convergence_report.md, proof/*.json, doctrine-update-phrase.md, operators-weekly.md), each with sealed: false until afproof lands a real proof_hash
